prior_importants.description: The claim read-back ("a second assignee means another session claimed it too") cannot detect a collision between sessions on the same GitHub account: both `--add-assignee @me` add the same login, so both sessions read back one assignee and work the same ticket.

findings.description: The Tickets section still says the assignee is the claim, but the updated Claim bullet (line 83) says the assignee alone cannot tell sessions apart and the earliest `claimed:` comment decides. Line 138 ("assign it to yourself before any work") has the same gap. Rewrite both to describe the assignee-plus-marker-comment protocol, or point to the Claim bullet.
findings.body:
The new [Claim bullet](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/db419254464a277c668a190379e9ab53d9308ee8/.claude/skills/wayfinder/SKILL.md#L83) says "Sessions share one GitHub login, so the assignee alone cannot tell two claimers apart". It now settles a claim by the earliest `claimed:` comment. Two other places in the file still describe the old assignee-only claim:

- [Line 67](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/db419254464a277c668a190379e9ab53d9308ee8/.claude/skills/wayfinder/SKILL.md#L67) defines the claim: "That assignee _is_ the claim: an open, unassigned ticket is unclaimed."
- [Line 138](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/db419254464a277c668a190379e9ab53d9308ee8/.claude/skills/wayfinder/SKILL.md#L138) is the step an agent actually runs in *Work through the map*: "**Claim it**: assign it to yourself before any work."

Line 138 reads as a complete instruction and does not point to line 83, and line 67 tells the agent the assignee settles the claim. So two sessions on the same login that follow step 2 both assign the ticket, each sees itself as the assignee, and both work it. Neither posts the marker or reads the comments back. That is the race the line-83 change was meant to close.

Keep the protocol in one place. On line 67, drop "That assignee _is_ the claim" and point to the Claim bullet in [Wayfinding operations](#wayfinding-operations). On line 138, write something like "**Claim it** (the Claim operation: assign, post the `claimed:` marker, read back) before any work." Line 82's frontier filter on assignees can stay, because a claimer still assigns first.
